new_primary_conclusions.title: Dynamic Negative Correlation Learning in Deep Ensemble Learning
new_primary_conclusions.publication: Proceedings of the 14th IIAE International Conference on Industrial Application Engineering 2026 (ICIAE2026)
new_primary_conclusions.read_kind: first scoped primary method read; all eight pages textual exposure declared; not full-paper certification
new_primary_conclusions.method: Uses GNCL L=lambda*L_cat+(1-lambda)*L_dis; basic lambda is previous-step L_cat/(L_cat+L_dis), with moving-average and confidence variants. Image classification, four same-architecture models; no graph frequency, neighbor residual or graph-conditioned metric.
new_primary_conclusions.quality_takeaway: Adaptive scalar tradeoffs are prior. Authors report DNCL lowest KL-diversity in the ResNet18/CIFAR10 comparison while reporting higher accuracy there; also report weaker results than some baselines for EfficientNet-B0/VGGNet16. Increased diversity alone is not the target.
source_ambiguities: Printed Eq2 uses k!=j and h_k(x_k), and Eq3 divides the M-member sum by N, despite N being data count; confirmed in page2 pixels. Do not port these literal NCL equations.
Basic Eq7 prose specifies previous-step losses. Eq8 substitutes same-symbol losses into the current objective; its instantaneous algebra is not the exact current loss/gradient under the lagged rule.
Step/epoch update granularity is mixed in prose; no author code checked.
Eq11 prints sigmoid of x_j and the prose calls it output confidence; exact classifier/probability aggregation is unresolved.
Ratio expression is degree-one homogeneous in losses, not an independently verified L2-regularization guarantee.
new_primary_conclusions.overlap: Strengthens fixed and adaptive GNCL controls. Does not establish an exact graph-restricted implementation duplicate or graph-conditioned quality guarantee.
